remarks: Nestled in the heart of Wilton, just moments from town, Gannett House is a rare offering where timeless charm meets exceptional possibility.  Thoughtfully stewarded by its current owners-a renowned architect and design duo-this enchanting vintage home has been lovingly refreshed and curated, creating a warm and inviting retreat that is as captivating today as it is inspiring for tomorrow.  Set on a picturesque property, the existing residence offers character, comfort, and thoughtful design at every turn. Thoughtful improvements, both inside and out, have beautifully prepared the home for its next chapter, while preserving the charm and authenticity that make it so special. Enjoy the thoughtfully refined footprint as it stands, or embrace a remarkable opportunity to bring an extraordinary vision to life.  For buyers inspired to further personalize the property, there is an opportunity to collaborate with the current designers to thoughtfully evolve the existing residence or realize the fully envisioned expansion.
